cart_items_via_cart.name: cart_items_via_cart
cart_items_via_cart.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM carts c WHERE c.id = "cart_items"."cart_id" AND (c.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.actor_id', true), '')::uuid OR c.guest_cart_id = nullif(current_setting('app.guest_cart_id', true), '') OR nullif(current_setting('app.actor_role', true), '') = 'ADMIN'))
cart_items_via_cart.withCheck: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM carts c WHERE c.id = "cart_items"."cart_id" AND (c.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.actor_id', true), '')::uuid OR c.guest_cart_id = nullif(current_setting('app.guest_cart_id', true), '') OR nullif(current_setting('app.actor_role', true), '') = 'ADMIN'))

carts_owner.name: carts_owner
carts_owner.using: "carts"."user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.actor_id', true), '')::uuid OR "carts"."guest_cart_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.guest_cart_id', true), '') OR nullif(current_setting('app.actor_role', true), '') = 'ADMIN'
carts_owner.withCheck: "carts"."user_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.actor_id', true), '')::uuid OR "carts"."guest_cart_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.guest_cart_id', true), '') OR nullif(current_setting('app.actor_role', true), '') = 'ADMIN'

carts_owner_xor.name: carts_owner_xor
carts_owner_xor.value: ("carts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("carts"."guest_cart_id" IS NOT NULL)

order_items_via_order.withCheck: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.id = "order_items"."order_id" AND (o.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.actor_id', true), '')::uuid OR nullif(current_setting('app.actor_role', true), '') = 'ADMIN'))
